tool: Packaged Food Label Compliance Screening Prototype
disclaimer: This prototype detects text patterns and retrieves regulatory passages. It does not establish legal compliance or verify that every applicable requirement has been met. Applicability depends on the product, label format, relevant regulations, exceptions and amendments. Verify current official requirements and inspect the original package before making a decision.
